叩く: to attack; to bash; to criticize; to censure
潔い: gracious (defeat, apology, etc.); graceful; honourable (e.g. death); noble
何ぼ: how much; how many; how; to what extent
座敷: dinner party in a tatami room (esp. when a geisha or maiko attends)
しょっぴく: to take (a suspect to the police); to drag (someone) away
ちょいちょい: often; frequently; now and then; occasionally
守る: to keep (i.e. a promise); to abide (by the rules); to observe; to obey
娑婆: the free world (outside of prison, the army, red light district, etc.)
梃入れ: shoring up (a company, industry, etc.); propping up; bolstering; support
出場: participation (in a tournament, match, race, etc.); entry; taking part (in); competing (in)

__flags__.鬼: 鬼仁会 is a group name (Kijinkai), 鬼 is a name fragment
__flags__.てこ: てことは = ということは, not 'lever'
__flags__.あない: あないなもん = あんなもん (that kind of thing), not 'guidance'

__flags__.干る: 懲りひん = Kansai negation ひん, not 'to dry'
__flags__.デッド: part of the name デッド・バンチャー
